scope: Development correspondence and image-model diagnostics; no physical selector or product integration

spec.operation: Classical SIFT reciprocal descriptor matches, deduplicated exact source/destination XY; one shared translation/affine/projective mapping of all reference parts. No independently chosen side shifts.
spec.match_ties: strict ratio, reciprocal matching, exact location deduplication by ratio/distance
spec.heldout: two folds, alternating unique source locations in Y/X order; fit transform on train only, report every heldout residual without an acceptance threshold. Correlated geometric diagnostics, not independent efficacy trials.
spec.limits: A shared mapping is appearance geometry, not camera truth or physical identity. Nonmatches are not occlusion/new fluid. A global projective model is not a general refractive model. Explicit local-warp and opaque-occluder controls test confounding. Raw descriptor support is not certified clear by center visibility.

content.stop_rule: No threshold/feature-count/scale/mask tuning after observation; weak support or multiple explanations do not grant authority. Proceed to bounded source inspection or a necessary human physical question, not a match-to-fluid classifier.
content.purpose: Establish whether multiple related reference features support a common mapping and locate correspondence/visibility ambiguities before designing a physical rule.
content.descriptor_context: raw fixed crop; no material/glare eligibility is claimed

content.reason: Per-channel gain=0 and offset=constant nests replacement within photometry and differential warp. No gain constraints or model tuning will be introduced. Corrected expectation is an observational tie, not positive occlusion detection.

content.operation: Use each already-saved native affine mapping (all matches and both heldout fits), converted by exact resize-center coordinates, to warp the reference into the fixed height-200 public raster or native sample4 raster. Never refit registration from residual outcomes.

models.photometry: independent per-channel gain and offset of registered reference (6 parameters)
models.differential_warp: same photometry plus shared X/Y central-gradient terms (8 parameters); a local optical opposition only, not a flow/identity estimate
models.replacement: constant current BGR appearance (3 parameters); a replacement-like fit, not proof of occlusion or fluid

content.support: fixed 16x16 tiles in working coordinates; full tile and reference gradient stencil must be visible/effective/nonglare with fully interpolable donors. Partial/crop tiles unavailable, without shrinking or repair.
content.fit: float64 least squares, normalized values /255; rcond=1e-10; every model must be full rank in both checkerboard folds. Strict lowest heldout MSE must agree in both folds; tie tolerance 1e-12. Scores retained, not calibrated physical probabilities.
content.counterexamples: Texture loss due to blur/glare and nonlinear optical deformation may look replacement-like. A differential first-order model is not a complete optical alternative; failure cannot establish occlusion.
content.stop_rule: No outcome-driven tile/threshold/registration/mask changes. Keep all explanations and missing support; do not convert residuals, model preference or reference nonmatch into a fluid classifier.

for r in graphs.values():inputs[r['arrays_path']]=r['arrays_sha256']
preflight={'schema':'s11-reference-pixels-preflight-v1','base_head':pre['base_head'],
 'operation':'Use each already-saved native affine mapping (all matches and both heldout fits), converted by exact resize-center coordinates, to warp the reference into the fixed height-200 public raster or native sample4 raster. Never refit registration from residual outcomes.',

def designs(ref,gx,gy):
    n=len(ref);photo=np.zeros((n,3,6))
    for c in range(3):photo[:,c,2*c]=ref[:,c];photo[:,c,2*c+1]=1
    warp=np.concatenate([photo,gx[:,:,None],gy[:,:,None]],axis=2)
    replacement=np.broadcast_to(np.eye(3),(n,3,3))
    return [photo,warp,replacement]

def compare(ref,cur,gx,gy):

    losses=np.full((2,3),np.nan);ranks=np.zeros((2,3),np.uint8)
    for fold,t in enumerate([train,~train]):

            if rank<A.shape[-1]:continue

            losses[fold,k]=np.mean((predicted-target[~t].ravel())**2)

        s,loss,rank=compare(ref,target,gx,gy);assert s==expected,(name,s,loss)
        out.append({'name':name,'status':'PASS','outcome':NAMES[s],'losses':loss.tolist()})

Also fit a direct endpoint trace from the same original vertices for temporal-baseline opposition. Report forward/backward numerical consistency and link deformation, not physical tracks.
content.track_lifecycle: Continue only if OpenCV status true and point finite/inside crop. First failure is terminal; no reinitialization, coordinate clamps, gap filling or identity transfer. Forward-backward error is measured, not used to select winners.
content.joint_context: Original graph links retain relationships; measure all surviving endpoint link lengths. This does not make independent local optical-flow estimates jointly constrained or establish material ownership.
content.visibility: Initial edges are the prior observed graph. Raw BGR grayscale LK support includes its complete image pyramid and can cross masks/materials or use OpenCV border extension. No current visibility or material eligibility is claimed by status, center bounds, or FB error.
content.new_observable: Every intervening source frame, unlike the rejected long-baseline unrestricted strip matching. Existing common-layout fit is opposition, not a displacement bound.
controls: smooth optical warp of one fixed pattern
content.stop_rule: No parameter/window/scale/error-cutoff tuning; no motion-to-fluid classifier. Existing physical judgments remain closed. New material ambiguity may require an original-image human review.
